scripts.build: prisma generate && cross-env NEXTAUTH_URL=https://www.rentipid.com.ph next build
scripts.test:db:setup: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- prisma db push
scripts.test:db:migrate: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test:db:reset: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.test:soc:integration: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test SECURITY_TELEMETRY_HMAC_KEY=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef SOC_CORRELATION_HMAC_KEY=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- jest --runInBand
scripts.test:oat: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- jest --runInBand tests/oat
scripts.knowledge:validate: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/knowledge/knowledge-runner.ts validate
scripts.knowledge:diff: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/knowledge/knowledge-runner.ts diff
scripts.knowledge:check: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/knowledge/knowledge-runner.ts check
scripts.knowledge:report: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/knowledge/knowledge-runner.ts report
scripts.knowledge:bootstrap: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_KNOWLEDGE_MUTATION=true dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/knowledge/knowledge-runner.ts bootstrap
scripts.knowledge:sync: npm run test:db:guard && cross-env NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_KNOWLEDGE_MUTATION=true dotenv -e .env.test.local -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/knowledge/knowledge-runner.ts sync
